audience: store owners and managers who run their shop on PHP Point of Sale

useCases.title: Find your best sellers and sales totals
useCases.text: The AI looks up one of the store's 138 reports, such as sales summary or top sellers, runs it for your dates and locations, and explains the result.

useCases.title: Find items that are below their reorder level
useCases.text: The AI lists items with category, supplier, prices and reorder level, or runs the low inventory report, so you know what to order.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their latest sales
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by email, phone or name, reads balance, tier and points, and lists their sales with line items and payments.

useCases.title: Check invoices and stock received
useCases.text: The AI lists customer invoices (money owed to you) or supplier invoices (money you owe), and receivings from suppliers by date range.

useCases.title: Create an item or update its fields
useCases.text: The AI searches items first, then creates a new item or changes fields such as price, category or active state on an existing one.

useCases.title: Add or change a customer, or record an expense
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer or changes the fields you pass, or records an expense with description, amount and date.
